entries.title: Morgan Stanley Facing Finra Probe on Client Vetting: WSJ
entries.summary: Morgan Stanley is being probed by the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority over its vetting of clients for the risk of money laundering from October 2021 through September 2024, according to the Wall Street Journal. Nicholas Comfort reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

entries.title: Japan Deal Revives Animal Spirits, Lifting Stocks to Records
entries.summary: Investors hope the agreement will be mimicked elsewhere. removing a cloud over markets.
entries.author: Simon Kennedy, Phil Serafino

entries.title: Continued Gains for Risk Assets Despite Tariffs: Shah
entries.summary: Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management, sees a constructive environment for stocks, but doesn’t expect double digit gains for the S&P 500 over the next 12 months as she examines the impact of tariffs on earnings.

entries.title: Tesla Earnings Preview: What to Watch for
entries.summary: Tesla Inc. is scheduled to report second-quarter earnings after the bell Wednesday, as investors look for signs of progress on the Robotaxi and autonomous driving and updates on its outlook for the full year amid an ongoing sales slump. Danny Lee has a preview on Bloomberg Television.

entries.title: Tesla’s Darkening Outlook to Test Robotaxi Vision Pushed by Musk
entries.summary: Tesla Inc.’s core car-making business is facing a deteriorating outlook, providing a major test of Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk’s ability to lift the stock price with his vision of a self-driving future.
entries.author: Esha Dey

entries.title: Horizons Middle East & Africa 07/23/2025
entries.summary: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg.  (Source: Bloomberg)

entries.title: Meme-Stock Doubters Eye Hedge-Fund Strategy to Bet on Reversal
entries.summary: Barclays Plc says that it’s about time to pump the brakes on a meme stock craze that’s driven sharp rallies in companies like Kohl’s Corp. and Opendoor Technologies Inc.
entries.author: Bernard Goyder

entries.title: Earnings Will Boost Stocks Despite Tariff Risks, Survey Shows
entries.summary: US stocks will shrug off tariff risks to get a boost from the second-quarter earnings season, the latest Markets Pulse survey showed.
entries.author: Tatiana Darie

entries.title: Wild Quarter for Crude Puts Big Oil Trading Desks in Spotlight
entries.summary: Big oil companies are forecast to post their lowest quarterly profits in four years after geopolitics whipsawed prices and left some of their traders on the wrong side of the volatility.
entries.author: Kevin Crowley, Mitchell Ferman

entries.title: GoPro, Krispy Kreme Surge as Markets Abuzz About Meme Stocks
entries.summary: The meme-stock revival looks like it might stretch into another day with GoPro Inc. and Krispy Kreme Inc. surging in early trading.
entries.author: Subrat Patnaik

entries.title: The More Deals Trump Gets, The More Confidence Markets Gain
entries.summary: The world’s investors are enjoying a confidence boost after months of uncertainty as President Donald Trump finally starts signing trade deals.
entries.author: Ruth Carson, Alice French

entries.title: South African Index Crosses Psychological Level of 100,000
entries.summary: South Africa’s benchmark stock index crossed the psychological level of 100,000 for the first time on optimism that a crucial budget vote will get support from key parties in the governing coalition.
entries.author: Mpho Hlakudi

entries.title: Luxury’s Gulf Between Winning and Losing Stocks Is Widening
entries.summary: For Europe’s luxury stocks, this earnings season will hammer home the widening gulf between the winners and the losers.
entries.author: Julien Ponthus, Sagarika Jaisinghani, Michael Msika

entries.title: RBI Injects $5.8 Billion Cash as Borrowing Costs Top Policy Rate
entries.summary: India’s central bank injected short-term cash into the financial system on Wednesday, as monthly tax payments drove overnight rates higher.
entries.author: Subhadip Sircar, Bhaskar Dutta

entries.title: Iberdrola Starts €5 Billion Share Sale for Grid Investment
entries.summary: Iberdrola started a €5 billion ($5.9 billion) capital increase, the biggest share sale in Europe so far this year, to bolster investments in power networks and further its US and UK expansion.
entries.author: Thomas Gualtieri

entries.title: Chinese Stocks in Hong Kong Rise to Highest Level In Four Years
entries.summary: A key gauge of Chinese stocks traded in Hong Kong rose to its highest close since October 2021, boosted by easing Sino-American trade tensions and gains in heavyweight tech shares.
entries.author: Winnie Hsu

entries.title: Stocks Power Ahead as US, Japan Strike Trade Deal: Markets Wrap
entries.summary: The record-breaking run in global stocks got fresh fuel after the US reached a trade deal with Japan, easing concern about the tariff war as traders turn their attention to earnings from US tech giants.
entries.author: Margaryta Kirakosian, Julien Ponthus
